Light training or mobility often feels good: walking, yoga, easy cycling. Feeling strong? Then just lift.
Extra sleep, warmth and iron-rich food can help. Resting is a smart choice, not a weakness.
Oestrogen rises: often more energy and quick recovery. A good moment for heavy sets, progression and new PRs.
You often recover quickly now. Still plan 1 or 2 rest days per week.
Often your peak moment for strength and explosiveness. Warm up well and watch your technique, especially around knees and jumps.
Joints can feel a bit looser. When in doubt, choose controlled reps.
Progesterone rises: steady strength at moderate intensity often works well. Heat feels heavier, so drink extra.
Towards the end, tiredness or PMS symptoms can appear. Easier training, walking and extra sleep are then perfectly fine.
